exact_statement: On a finite uniform physical cube let an exclusive controller kappa select k independent disjoint Boolean data cores with actual remaining means m_j, and fix one own-history physical controller policy T for all Boolean output labelings. For each labeling epsilon let r_epsilon be its supplied nonnegative C-priced controller potential. The actual complete-data controller-boundary reserve has mean-only harmonic extension P=sum_epsilon product_j[(1+epsilon_j m_j)/2] r_epsilon. This is the unique such extension on all physically realizable mean vectors; it is a DATA martingale and satisfies E_epsilon Inf_i(g_epsilon)=Inf_i(F) and E_epsilon D_i(g_epsilon)<=C Inf_i(F)+P-E P_child at each controller query. For three labels and sign-invariant least reserves r_j=Q_C(1-2C_j,T), P=sum_j w_j r_j with w_j=[1+m_l m_s-m_j(m_l+m_s)]/4, w_j>=0, sum_j w_j<=1, and w_j+w_l=(1-m_j m_l)/2 on a j-to-l edge. Binary labels recover delta*r_h. With existing rarity bank R=sum_j phi(q_j)(1-m_j^2), the residual E_i=D_i(F)-sum_j w_j D_i(1-2C_j)-(R-E R_child) remains explicit. Exhaustive exact certificates prove max positive E_i/Inf_i(F)=3 over all at-most-two-control three-state label maps and disjoint constant/dictator cores, including all partial histories. Support relabeling extends E_i<=3Inf_i(F) to arbitrary disjoint parity cores under every partial DATA exposure for these controller maps. Conditional on the scoped reviewed A064 local data lift, P+R is a nonnegative potential at alpha=max(11/2,C+3) for all compatible finite parity-core/controller interleavings. The three-state table(1,1,2,3) with independent dictators has C1 cut reserves(0,3/2,3/2), P=3/4, R=3/2 and actual root Q1=9/4; dropping the two nonzero cut reserves loses3/4. Its live child has E_i=1,d_i=1/2, refuting a zero-price residual extension. No arbitrary-controller/non-flat-core correction or inherited initial reserve bound is asserted.
